title: Brothers in Dapper White Suits, 1938 Fullerton California Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription: 817 A FADE PROOF SEP 6 1938 Finished by B. D. WOOD Fullerton, California
description: A full-length snapshot of two smiling brothers posed against a painted brick wall on September 6, 1938. The older brother wears an elegant white double-breasted suit jacket with peak lapels, cuffed matching trousers, and a dark-striped necktie, standing with his hands behind his back. The younger boy stands beside him wearing a stylish white sailor-inspired outfit consisting of belted shorts and an open sailor collar jacket over a button-up shirt. The photograph was processed and stamped by commercial photo finisher B. D. Wood in Fullerton, California, reflecting classic late-Depression era American youth formalwear.
